notes: Run in a throwaway repo with a small module, a passing test suite, and a last commit that seeds two real bugs. For the pasted-review case, also give a review with one true and two false claims. Script checks are marked script.

evals.prompt: call council of 3 sonnet to review our last commit then vedict then fix it
evals.expected_output: States the scope (the last commit) and the panel (3 sonnet) before spawning, gives reviewers no session conclusions, merges findings, verifies each with a test or probe, fixes only confirmed ones starting from failing tests, reruns the suite, has a fresh reviewer check the fixes, and reports one row per finding.

assertions.text: both seeded bugs have a new test that fails before the fix and passes after
full test suite passes at the end
every finding has a verdict with evidence

evals.prompt: [pasted review with 3 claims] vedict this then fix all confirmed bug for me
evals.expected_output: Spawns no review panel, checks each pasted claim against the code, confirms the true one with a reproducing test, rejects the two false ones with evidence, and fixes only the true one.

assertions.text: only the true claim's code changed
the two false claims are marked REJECTED with a reason
